capabilities: Style links by tag, frontmatter or Dataview attribute, or folder path
Set light and dark mode colors, backgrounds, weights, decorations and borders
Add prefix and suffix icons or emojis to links
Apply styling in editor, reading view, sidebars, tabs and Bases
Print and reset styling performance telemetry from the command palette
extras: README stresses performance on very large vaults and includes diagnostic telemetry commands; MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: bring the beloved Supercharged Links workflow up to modern Obsidian standards
motivation: The author wanted to bring the Supercharged Links workflow up to modern Obsidian standards, which led into performance work on CodeMirror 6 and multi-window rendering.
problem: Internal links all look alike, so a target note's tags, folder or properties cannot be read at a glance in the editor, sidebars or switcher.
